capabilities: Open a draggable, snap-to-grid workbench dashboard
Capture daily time entries, expenses, quick notes, and meditation
Browse recent journal entries in a 3D carousel with a streak heatmap
Track today's must-do tasks and import tasks from TickTickSync
View project stage Gantt charts and progress
disambiguation: Not a developer workbench; it is a personal productivity dashboard for journals, tasks, and projects.
extras: The weather module is disabled by default and kept as a reserved placeholder; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it as a personal tool that evolves with their own workflow.
problem: Obsidian has no single dashboard view that pulls daily journaling, time tracking, expenses, tasks, and project progress together in one place.

relations.evidence: read-only import from the TickTickSync plugin's local cache (never writes back to TickTick)

summary: Draggable modular dashboard that combines daily journaling, time and expense capture, tasks, and project Gantt charts for PARA-style vaults.
